args.question: What did the issuer find in the pre-arbitration review, and is there any further evidence the cardholder has provided?

args.reason: AVS, CVV, device and IP evidence all match the cardholder and delivery is proven; the required fraud evidence is held.

args.explanation: Fraud dispute 10.5 on USD 74.58 (seed 6004). Read the case, all five evidence documents and the ledger. Asked the issuer for the statement; the cardholder said they did not make the purchase. Evidence held: receipt, authorization record, AVS/CVV match (Y/M), device and IP match to the cardholder, and USPS delivery proof. I represented on 2026-02-03 with all of it. The case moved to pre-arbitration; I accepted no liability and checked the pre-arbitration window on 2026-02-18. I escalated to network arbitration on 2026-02-18 because the evidence matched the required kinds. The network ruled for the merchant on 2026-03-20 and the chargeback was reversed. The merchant paid the 15.00 USD chargeback fee and the 25.00 USD pre-arbitration fee. Deadlines were met.
